name: Miyamae Kouhei
source:
The protagonist. A dull university student. The time he doesn't have a girlfriend is equal to the time he is alive. Hobbies include reading and games. 

He's a good guy, but has nothing aside from it. One winter, he'll experience the best godsend in his life. 

[Translated from [url=http://yorunohitsuji.xii.jp/products/sisbitch]Official Site[/url]]
